_: Keyframes on frames, [frame, left edge], the crop of the piece before the first, and the left edge the crop has on each frame. A keyframe switches the crop on its frame and holds it until the next. The engine's heldX and the window's heldLeft in lib/keyframes.ts are both held to it, see TestTheHoldIsTheOneTheVideoPreviewWorksOut in engine/cropmarks_test.go.
